newsitem.title: USA: Dayton Hudson October same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Dayton Hudson October same store sales up.

text.p: Dayton Hudson Corp said Thursday its same store sales for the four weeks ended November 2 rose six percent from the same period a year ago.
Net retail sales for that period increased 12.3 percent to $1.89 billion from $1.68 billion a year ago.
Dayton said all of its divisions were ahead of plan in October. Profit momentum in the first half of the year has continued at both Target and Mervyn's.
Dayton said its Target division's total sales for the month increased 17.4 percent and comparable store sales increased 9.6 percent.
Year-to-date, Target's total sales increased 16.1 percent and comparable store sales increased 7.2 percent.
Dayton said its Mervyn's division's total sales for the month increased 0.1 percent, but comparable store sales decreased 0.9 percent.
Year-to-date, Mervyn's total sales decreased 0.3 percent and comparable store sales decreased 2.3 percent.

Dayton said the Department Store Division's total sales for the month increased 5.6 percent and comparable store sales decreased 0.4 percent. Year-to-date, the Department Stores total sales decreased 0.4 percent and comparable-store sales decreased 3.5 percent.

Total company sales for the 39 weeks ended November 2 were $16.85 billion, up 10.7 percent from $15.22 billion in the same period a year ago. Comparable store sales for the 39-week period were up 3.9 percent compared to the same period last year.
